### Mod Information:
* Champion: Mordekaiser
* Modified skin: Default
* Author: お兄ちゃんの苗床
* Description: Replaces base Morde with Kotori from Date A Live

琴里ちゃんのロリポップぺろぺろしたい。。。ぺろぺろぺろぺろ

### Features:
* New model and texture
* Supports all champion texture quality settings
* Modified loadingscreen
* Modified in-game/skill icons
* Modified particles
* Modified animations
* Edited ability sounds
* New voiceover fully replacing Morde’s 100+ lines

### Credits
* Model from 300 Heroes
* Visual assets from Date A Live anime and LNs, Tsunako artbooks
* Voiceover primarily from Date A Live Spirit Pledge, partially other  DAL collab mobage (Mega Miracle Force, Fantasia Rebuild, Assault Lily  etc)
* Dance emote music from Date A Live character song Melt (On The Border)
